overview.about: The Portland Classic is one of the longest continuously run tournaments in LPGA history, played at Columbia Edgewater Country Club in Oregon. Its deep roots and loyal Pacific Northwest following make it a beloved fixture of the tour.
overview.nextEvent: The next Portland Classic is played at Columbia Edgewater Country Club in Portland, Oregon. The mature, tree-lined layout and long history give the week a traditional, community feel.
